title: Narrow string tree ordering
summary: Recovered VA 0x422c50 as a stateless thiscall member comparator using unsigned lexicographic byte ordering and explicit string lengths. Original storage union is at +0, length +16, capacity +20; capacity >=16 selects a pointer. Callers pass node keys at +16 and consume AL only. No input writes occur.
test_description: 25992 differential cases against original_narrow_tree_key_less with both inline/heap combinations, lengths 0..40 (inline <=15), heap capacities 16 and UINT32_MAX, equal strings, prefixes, early/middle/late differences, unsigned high bytes, embedded NULs and aliasing. Expected ordering is checked independently; entire fixtures including unused storage, canaries and backing buffers plus comparator state remain unchanged. FS setup must succeed and head restoration is checked after each oracle call.
known_limits: No matching-byte claim; implementation expresses the helper semantics directly.
Only valid readable storage is supported; malformed lengths, dangling pointers and concurrent mutation are outside the original valid-object contract.
32-bit original layout and ABI validated; native pointer width changes layout on 64-bit ports.
Range helper throwing paths are unreachable with the comparator's zero position and are outside scope.
